### The contract
1. **Generated entries.** Each command below, when its actor is Spud, writes exactly one `report.entry` event in the same transaction as the record it makes: actor `spud`, `ticket_id` set (and `member_id` for `member finish`), `data` `{"title": <title>, "generated": "<the command, e.g. member finish>"}`, and a body of `- ` lines (possibly none). A command that is refused or fails (exit 1, 3, 4 or 5) writes no entry.
   - `ticket new`: `SPD-nnn created (<status>, <priority>): <ticket title>`.
   - `ticket move`: `SPD-nnn <verb>: <ticket title>`, the verb by the new status: `active` gives `started`, `done` gives `done`, `queued` gives `queued`, `declined` gives `declined`.
   - `ticket edit` when `--priority` changes the priority: `SPD-nnn priority <old> to <new>: <ticket title>`. An edit that changes no priority writes no entry.
   - `member finish` of a root member (Spud is the parent): `SPD-nnn: <Name> (<lineage>, <persona>, <model>) <status>`, with the body line `- <summary>` when the member has a summary after the command. A nested parent's `member finish` writes no entry: report entries are Spud's.
   - `proposal decide` by Spud: `--decision create` gives `SPD-nnn created from a proposal by <proposer handle> (<status>, <priority>): <ticket title>`, one entry only (not a second one for the ticket it creates); `--decision decline` gives `Proposal declined: <proposal title> (from <proposer handle>)` with the body line `- Reason: <reason>`.
2. **`--next "<prose>"`** on `ticket new`, `ticket move`, `ticket edit`, `member finish` and `proposal decide`, optional. It appends `- Next: <prose>` as the entry's last body line. Any actor but Spud passing it is exit 3 and nothing is written; an empty value, or a `ticket edit` that writes no entry, is exit 2 and nothing is written.
3. **Output.** When an entry is written, `--json` gains `report_entry` (`id`, `at`, `title`, `body`) and the text gains the line `report entry HH:MM — <title> added to reports/<day>.md`, the same wording `report add` prints today.
4. **`report add "<title>" --next "…"`** is unchanged: it stays for what no command records (a merge, an install). Its help says so.
5. **Rendering and import.** `render_report` needs no change: a generated entry renders as its heading and then its body lines, in event order. Days rendered before this ticket stay byte-identical, so `tests/test_acceptance.py` passes untouched. `import --file` of a day file holding generated entries accepts it with nothing added and nothing refused (`accept_report_edit`, `bin/spud:2346`; `parse_report_entries`, `bin/spud:846`, already reads multi-line bodies).
6. **`SessionStart`.** The generated matcher becomes `startup|resume|clear|compact` (`bin/spud:2736`), so a `/clear` gets the board too; `hook SessionStart` with source `clear` injects it as it does for the others.

Surface as built
- The event: kind report.entry, actor spud, ticket_id set, member_id set only for member finish, data {"title": <title>, "generated": "ticket new" | "ticket move" | "ticket edit" | "member finish" | "proposal decide"}, a body of "- " lines with "- Next: <prose>" last when --next is given, and no Next line otherwise.
- Titles: "SPD-nnn created (<status>, <priority>): <title>" (ticket new); "SPD-nnn started|done|queued|declined: <title>" by the new status (ticket move); "SPD-nnn priority <old> to <new>: <title>", the title as the edit leaves it (ticket edit); "SPD-nnn: <Name> (<lineage>, <persona>, <model>) <status>" with "- <summary>" when the member has a summary after the command (member finish); "SPD-nnn created from a proposal by SPUD-nnn/<Name> (<status>, <priority>): <title>", ticket_id the created ticket, one entry only (proposal decide create); "Proposal declined: <proposal title> (from SPUD-nnn/<Name>)" with "- Reason: <reason>", ticket_id the proposal's ticket (proposal decide decline).
